Research depth: all 64 districts have now been individually researched with named, dated sources (originally 20 districts, since expanded to full national coverage with a dedicated deep-research pass on the remaining 44) — see the companion Excel workbook's "Expansion Notes" tab for full district-by-district sourcing. One limitation still applies uniformly to all 64: three indicators (power/gas reliability, banking density, broadband/mobile coverage) rely on analyst estimates rather than official district-level datasets, since no single authoritative source exists for these three specifically — see the workbook's "Data Basis Notes" tab.
